patterns.note: Extensive use of horizontal scrolling carousels for product displays and editorial content, allowing for dense content presentation without excessive vertical scrolling.
Asymmetrical grid layouts for editorial sections, combining larger hero images with smaller, multi-column article cards.
A sophisticated pairing of a classic, elegant serif font for prominent headings and a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation, creating a high-end editorial feel.
A minimalist and neutral color palette (white, light grey, black, subtle cream) that allows the rich product photography and editorial imagery to be the primary source of color and visual interest.
A sticky header navigation that remains visible at the top of the viewport after initial scroll, providing persistent access to key site sections.
Multiple horizontal scrolling content sections (powered by Swiper) that allow users to browse collections of products or articles without leaving the current page section.
Clear visual separation between content blocks using full-width background colors (mostly white) and distinct heading styles, creating a modular and easy-to-scan page structure.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header navigation that collapses slightly in height after the initial scroll, maintaining brand presence and key links.
Content sections are organized into a vertical stack, with many sections featuring horizontal carousels for browsing items, implemented using a JavaScript slider library like Swiper.
The overall page structure uses a clean grid system for product and editorial cards, often with asymmetrical arrangements to add visual interest.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (hero ~4x body, section headings ~2x body) paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation, creating a sophisticated and editorial hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (2-4px) on buttons and some image containers, but predominantly sharp edges for a clean, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within editorial layouts, while product grids maintain a tighter, consistent rhythm.

standout: The site masterfully blends high-end e-commerce with rich editorial content, creating a sophisticated online magazine experience where shopping feels integrated with discovery. The extensive use of horizontal scrolling carousels for both products and articles is a distinctive pattern that encourages exploration and keeps the user on the page.
